# Security policy

## Scope

This repository includes a documentation application, example code, and reusable UI packages. Report vulnerabilities affecting the repository or its published packages.

## Reporting

Do not post credentials, exploit details, or private data in a public issue. Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting if enabled for this repository. Otherwise, contact the maintainer through the current private method on the [GitHub profile](https://github.com/hmzainjamil).

Include affected package/path, impact, and safe reproduction steps. Do not include secrets or user data. No response time or supported-version promise is made by this file.

## Safe use

Review application integrations and provider configuration before sending user prompts or data to external services. Keep deployment tokens and API credentials in protected secret storage, not in source files.
